subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Others entered by mistake and were asked to lower their voices.”?
options: Then another student added the correct salt too.
The city added parking zones and small fines.
The company added clearer signs and announcements.
A month later, the announcements became slower.

本文可直接核對「Others entered by mistake and were asked to lower their voices. The company added clearer signs and announcements.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
